question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NVIDIA's own recent quarterly GAAP opex guides, which have stepped ~$0.8-0.9B above prior-quarter actual (6.80->7.7, 7.62->8.5, 8.41->9.2). Q3 actuals likely ~9.1B (actuals land slightly below guide), implying Q4 guide ~9.9-10.0B. Cross-check: Q2 call guided FY27 non-GAAP opex growth 'low 50s' (raised from 'upper 40s'); with FY26 recast base ~22.7B this implies FY ~34.3-34.7B, leaving Q4 non-GAAP ~9.7-10.1B, GAAP ~+0.2B => 9.9-10.3B. Upside risk: another raise of the full-year growth rate or acquisition-related GAAP costs; downside: a light Q3 or a conservative guide. No prediction market found for opex guidance (Polymarket/Kalshi only on beats/mention words; Manifold on revenue).

- Q2 FY27 actual opex: GAAP $8,408M, non-GAAP $8,232M (up 10%/11% seq). Q1 FY27 actual: GAAP $7,621M, non-GAAP $7,449M (GAAP +12% seq, +52% YoY). Source: Q2 FY27 PR, Q1 CFO commentary.

- Full-year FY27 non-GAAP opex growth commentary: 'upper 40s' at Q1 call (May 2026), raised to 'low 50s' at Q2 call (Aug 2026), driven by portfolio broadening, AI tool usage, compute infrastructure, compensation (Fool transcripts).
- Implied arithmetic: FY26 non-GAAP recast base ~22.6-22.8B (estimated, not found published); 51-53% growth => FY27 ~34.1-34.9B; Q1+Q2 actual+Q3 guide non-GAAP = 24.68B => Q4 non-GAAP residual ~9.4-10.2B; add ~0.2B for GAAP.
- Status quo: NVIDIA always gives GAAP opex as single 'approximately' figure (resolves on that figure, rounded to 0.1B).
- Resolves off GAAP opex figure in Outlook section of the Q3 FY27 press release (expected 2026-11-17), not non-GAAP, not the call commentary.
- Event window: single release 2026-11-17; as of 2026-10-27 the guide has not been issued.
